scope: Offline evaluation only; never import policy or review code into production

human_review_gate.identities: Human attestations require external verification; software does not authenticate people

design_gate.failure_action: Block canonical evaluation; report measured imbalance without padding evidence or moving cases using retrieval outcomes

retrieval.database: Dedicated ctxd_phase10 only; never truncate application ctxd or prior phase databases
retrieval.hybrid: Production parallel deterministic RRF k=60; top_k=10 implies depth20 per branch; other top_k values have dynamic depth
retrieval.token_counter: Unchanged production ApproximateTokenCounter, not BPE or model tokens
retrieval.packing_input: fixed top10 chunks; preserve identity, content, cost, tenant and source
retrieval.production_parity: Verify offline greedy selection against actual ContextAssembler for every case/budget

packing.source: Existing ctxd.app.evals.context_selection.pack; no new ranking or packing algorithms
packing.selection_gate: On approved development cases: no case-budget required-recall or answerability regressions; >=5% lower total selected tokens with no aggregate evidence loss, or >=0.02 higher mean full answerability with <=5% token growth. Evidence improvement must have positive 95% template-cluster interval lower bound. Token saving must have negative token-delta upper bound. No provenance-regression challenges may fail. If none pass, freeze none.
packing.tie_break: Highest mean full answerability, then required recall, then lowest selected tokens, then policy name
packing.holdout: Exactly one frozen policy versus greedy, or no comparative holdout if none selected; checksums and durable start marker required before access; do not delete markers or retune from outcomes

reranking.scope: Development-only replay, if independently reviewed evidence and design gates pass

metrics.uncertainty: At least 2000 paired template-cluster bootstrap resamples, seed 1002026; report cluster counts; zero deltas do not prove equivalence
metrics.causality: Overlapping labels are diagnostics, not unobserved causal claims. Duplicate waste requires removable text duplication without losing labeled complete or partial evidence. Text equality alone never establishes evidence equivalence. Semantic conflict is not inferred by string matching.
